title: Create your WordPress.com website by chatting with AI
text:
Build your site in minutes with AI
Create your WordPress.com website by chatting with AI
Start with an idea — watch it become a website
Our text-to-design flow uses simple conversational prompts and AI-powered design suggestions to create a professional WordPress website in no time.
AI builds the site — you make it yours
Customize templates, color palettes, and design elements with intuitive tools — or prompt AI to do it for you.
Less time building, more time growing
Save hours by letting AI handle the heavy lifting of content generation and layout optimization in the editor, freeing you up to focus on your goals.
Create a portfolio to share my photography
Start a landing page for my bakery
Show me more color palettes
Pick a layout
Looks good, let’s launch!
Built with AI, loved by users
AI website
builder FAQ
What is an AI website builder?
WordPress.com’s AI website builder lets you describe your site in plain language and generates a complete WordPress website — layouts, images, and content — in minutes. Just type what you need, answer a few questions, and the AI handles the design and copy. No coding or design experience needed.
How is an AI website builder different from a regular website builder?
While traditional web page builders often require manual design work, an AI-powered website builder generates a complete site — layouts, images, and text — for you based on your input. You can then fine-tune the design and content to get a professional website with AI efficiency.
How does the AI website builder work?
Describe your website in a few words — your site’s purpose, style, and any preferences. The AI asks a few follow-up questions, then generates a complete site with layouts, images, and content. From there, you can refine anything by continuing to chat with the AI or by editing directly in the WordPress editor. When you’re happy, hit publish.
How long does it take to create a website with AI?
Most sites are ready in under 5 minutes. Describe your site, answer a few questions, and the AI generates a complete layout with images and content. You can then refine it as long as you like before going live.
What kinds of sites can I build with the WordPress.com AI website builder?
The AI website builder can create a wide range of sites — personal blogs, professional portfolios, photography showcases, business homepages, landing pages, nonprofit sites, coaching pages, and more. If you want to add an online store, you can do that too by installing WooCommerce after your site is live.
Can I customize the AI-generated website?
Yes — fully. The AI gives you a complete starting point, but you have total control over layouts, colors, fonts, and content. You can keep chatting with the AI to make changes (“make the header bigger,” “switch to a darker color palette”) or edit anything manually in the WordPress block editor. Both approaches work side by side.
Can I install plugins on a site created with the AI website builder?
Yes. Once your AI-generated site is up and running, it’s just like any other WordPress.com site — and you can expand it with plugins on any paid plan starting with Personal. This means you have access to more than 50,000 plugins from the WordPress.org directory to add contact forms, SEO tools, membership features, ecommerce, and more.
Does the AI website builder work for online stores?
The AI website builder is focused on generating blogs, portfolios, landing pages, and business sites. To add a full online store, install WooCommerce from the plugin directory — available on paid plans. You’ll get product pages, a shopping cart, payments, and more, built on top of the AI-generated foundation.
What makes WordPress.com’s AI website builder different from other AI builders?
AI builders lock you into a proprietary platform. WordPress.com is built on open-source WordPress, so your content, your domain, and your site are always yours. You get access to 50,000+ plugins, thousands of themes, and a hosting infrastructure trusted by millions of sites — not just a starter site with nowhere to grow.
Can I connect a custom domain to my AI-built website?
Yes. You can connect a custom domain on any paid plan, giving your site a professional, branded web address. You can also register a new domain directly through WordPress.com.
What happens after I launch my website?
Your site keeps getting smarter after launch. The WordPress Agent stays available in the editor to help you update content, add new sections, or restyle pages — just keep prompting. You can also update and add content manually anytime, and your site is backed by WordPress.com’s hosting, security, and support.
